name: Fixed-Width Bit Packer
description: GPU fixed-width bit-packing stage. Forward: packs (v - base) >> shift using only the low nbits bits into a dense byte stream. Inverse: unpacks and restores (packed << shift) + base. nbits must be a power of two (allowed: u8→{1,2,4,8}; u16→{1,2,4,8,16}; u32→{1,2,4,8,16,32}). The optional shift transform combines a frame-of-reference base (removes dead high bits, always lossless) with a right shift (removes dead low bits; lossless only when every value has that many trailing zeros). Auto modes (autoDetect / autoBase / autoShift) derive nbits, base, and shift from a GPU scan of the input; any of them makes the stage incompatible with CUDA Graph capture. Default configuration (base=0, shift=0) is lossless.

config.name: nbits
config.description: Bits per element. Must be a power of two in [1, 8*sizeof(T)]. Identity (no compression) at the default.

config.name: autoDetect
config.description: Scan input for max value and pick the smallest valid power-of-two nbits. Requires a D2H sync; incompatible with CUDA Graph capture.

config.name: base
config.description: Frame-of-reference offset subtracted before packing and added back on unpack. Removes dead high bits when values cluster away from zero. Always lossless.

config.name: shift
config.description: Right shift applied after the base subtraction, removing dead low bits. LOSSY unless every (v - base) has this many trailing zeros; use autoShift for the provably lossless value. Must be in [0, 8*sizeof(T)-1].

config.name: autoBase
config.description: Min-reduce the input and use the minimum as base. Lossless. Requires a D2H sync; incompatible with CUDA Graph capture.

config.name: autoShift
config.description: OR-reduce every (v - base) and use the trailing-zero count as shift, i.e. the largest shift that drops no information. Always lossless. Requires a D2H sync; incompatible with CUDA Graph capture.
